plan.line: a BME280 pressure sensor module (I2C): measures air pressure (300-1100 hPa), temperature and humidity; from the pressure it can estimate altitude and help forecast the weather. The cheaper BMP280 looks the same but has no humidity. Uses one I2C bus (at most 2 I2C parts).

code.pinLine: BME280 pressure sensor {ref} on I2C{bus} (SDA {gpio}, SCL {scl}): i2c{n} = I2C({bus}, sda=Pin({g}), scl=Pin({sclG}), freq=400000) and sensor{n} = BME280(i2c{n}). t, p, h = sensor{n}.read() gives temperature in C, pressure in hPa and humidity in % (h is None on a BMP280, so check before printing it). sensor{n}.altitude() estimates metres above sea level from the pressure (weather moves it by tens of metres). A new reading is ready about every second.
handoff: | {scl} | {sclPhys} | {ref} SCL | i2c{bus}_scl | `sensor = BME280(i2c); t, p, h = sensor.read()` |
code.moduleRule: bme280 when a pressure sensor is listed
